description.en: A task that is not a code change, done end to end by one helper: a page in the owner's signed-in browser, a mailbox, a cloud console, a deploy with an SSH or FTP account from Env Catalog. The accounts are checked first (nothing starts when one is missing or left out of the project list); the helper then works with the errand brief and ends with an ERRAND: done or ERRAND: blocked line. It never changes, commits or pushes the project's files (a repository edit makes the errand blocked), and its report passes the output guard. Started by lane_pilot_errand and by a schedule of kind errand; works in a project that has no PM chat.
description.ru: Задача, которая не правка кода, выполненная одним помощником от начала до конца: страница в браузере владельца с его входом, почта, облачная консоль, выкладка по SSH или FTP с учёткой из Env Catalog. Сначала проверяются учётки (если одной нет или она вне списка проекта, ничего не запускается); затем помощник работает по записке поручения и заканчивает строкой ERRAND: done или ERRAND: blocked. Он не правит, не коммитит и не пушит файлы проекта (правка репозитория делает поручение blocked), а отчёт проходит проверку вывода. Запускается через lane_pilot_errand и расписанием вида «поручение»; работает и в проекте без PM-чата.

not_for: a code change: that goes through lane_pilot_dispatch_writer
anything a person asks for in a chat: the PM starts this with lane_pilot_errand, a schedule with its errand task

task.note: the whole task: the goal, where, what to report

authorized.note: the owner authorized the reversible changes the task needs inside his accounts; false reads and reports only

accounts.note: Env Catalog names the helper may read for this task

plugins.note: BB plugin ids the helper loads besides the errand role's (image-studio)

mcp.note: MCP server names the helper loads (blender)

model.note: empty: the errand role's model (claude-opus-5-5, high)

detached.note: a hidden thread of the project with no parent chat (a schedule's); also the case when the project has no PM chat

nodes.rule: code: every Env Catalog name the errand lists exists, is of a usable kind and is allowed for the project; otherwise the run stops here and says what to fix. Nothing is read from the catalog but the names

proof.reason: the helper's own report; the closing ERRAND: line, the repository check and the output guard decide done or blocked
proof.form: errandVerdict: the last line is ERRAND: done or ERRAND: blocked: <why>; a report without it is blocked (no_marker)

input.task: Open the CRM and report the number of new leads.

test.live: from a PM chat call lane_pilot_errand with a read-only page check, then lane_pilot_wait_errand with the workflowRunId; or run a schedule of kind errand now and read its run
